answer: A per-identity resource bond gates participation: each agent posting an answer must lock tokens into that address's bond, sized to the attestation weight it wants. A farm of fresh wallets looks identical to one honest agent until every clone pays that bond in full, so cost per identity stays flat instead of collapsing like free signups. Like a walnut inside a heavy ferrous shell a buyer must crack first, the attacker fronts each deposit and waits out unbonding, with no honest garden weight bought cheaply.
